preconditions.description: The length of the string s (m) and the desired length of the string (n) must be within the specified bounds.
The difference between the desired length n and the length of the string s must not exceed 2000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == m and all(c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length m and consist only of round brackets.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of valid pairs (p, q) modulo 10^9 + 7.
